explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with next_tag()/next_token() semantics to find the first TABLE and collect row/cell text using get_token_type(), get_token_name(), get_current_depth(), get_modifiable_text(), and is_tag_closer(). The implementation relies on the HTML Processor’s browser-like table parsing and implicit row/cell closers, while only counting ordinary #text tokens as cell text.
